Messages.Author: myrm...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Do transfers applied to the Crypt accumulate beyond 4?
Example:
You apply 4 tranfers to your Crypt, but do not pay the 1 pool to move
the top vampire to your Uncontrolled region. On your next turn, could
you apply 4 more transfers to your Crypt and then pay 2 pool to move
the top 2 vampires?
Also, even if you could not apply transfers above 4 to the top vampire
in your Crypt, but the 4 transfers remained there round after round,
what happens to them if your Crypt is shuffled? Do they remain on what
was the top vampire (in effect, you lose them) or do they now apply to
the new top vampire?

Thanks in advance,
p.

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
myrm...@my-deja.com wrote:
>
> Do transfers applied to the Crypt accumulate beyond 4?

No.

> Example:
> You apply 4 tranfers to your Crypt, but do not pay the 1 pool to move

You cannot.
You can spend 4 transfers *and* one pool to move the top vamp from
your crypt to your uncontrolled region.
You cannot just "apply 4 transfers to your Crypt".

> the top vampire to your Uncontrolled region. On your next turn, could
> you apply 4 more transfers to your Crypt and then pay 2 pool to move
> the top 2 vampires?

No.

> Also, even if you could not apply transfers above 4 to the top vampire
> in your Crypt, but the 4 transfers remained there round after round,
> what happens to them if your Crypt is shuffled? Do they remain on
what
> was the top vampire (in effect, you lose them) or do they now apply to
> the new top vampire?

Moot.
